pages.text: Mekanism is the primary T3–$(t4)T4$() tech mod. Ore processing, gas handling, advanced machines, and the road to $(item)MekaSuit$().

$(bold)T3 access:$() Basic Mekanism machines (Enrichment Chamber, Purification Chamber, Crusher, Chemical Injection) unlock at T3. Osmium is the $(t3)T3$() base material.$(br2)$(bold)Ore processing:$() Full Mekanism processing chain yields up to 5 ingots per ore. Building this chain is a major $(t3)T3$() engineering project.

$(bold)T4 upgrade:$() $(item)MekaTool$(), Mekasuit, QIO Network, Fusion Reactor, and Antimatter production are $(t4)T4$() content. Planning your $(t3)T3$() infrastructure for $(t4)T4$() upgrades is a good use of $(t3)T3$() time.$(br2)$(bold)Artificer synergy:$() Efficient Engineering boosts all Mekanism factory speeds. $(t3)T3$() Artificer is the fastest path to T4.
$(bold)No book needed.$() Mekanism is documented via JEI and the $(bold)Mekanism wiki$() (mekanismmod.com). In-game, hover any machine in JEI and press $(bold)R$() for recipes, $(bold)U$() for uses.
